title: AI concept art for my new Viking survival crafter - how long until we can make games of this quality and look?
author: sharkymcstevenson2

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body:
You can make a game today that looks like this.

Just make sure you know how to texture 3d objects and rig the character.

You can create 3D assets for every object in this image and ask AI to help you create the proper lighting. Use Unreal or Unity HDRP.

A diorama that looks exactly like this is possible.

Next challenge is to actually make a game.

replies.author: Siduron
replies.body: I feel like AI can get 90% there but 3d assets still look janky when you take a good look at them.

replies.author: Siduron
replies.body:
It depends. Is it reasonable to expect you should be able to clean up a generated asset to make it game ready? Then yes I don't have the skills to do that.

Or should AI be able to make assets 100% ready to implement? I'm trying to figure this out.

replies.author: kytheon
replies.body: AI can make assets 100% ready to implement. Source: I did.

replies.author: Siduron
replies.body: Could you elaborate on your workflow or link to some resources on how to do this? I'm very curious to get through the last 10% towards making asset game ready.

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Im not sure I agree on that tbh, I havent seen a game with this level of polish yet and this is all I do every day. haha

replies.author: kytheon
replies.body:
"This is all I do"

Rendering images?

replies.author: kytheon
replies.body:
So you make games with AI but doubt whether you can make games with AI.

Or are you just full time lurking this sub.

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body:
Making games with AI is a spectrum - or maybe you don’t understand that? 

Show me an AI game that looks like this if you’ve seen one, id be happy to be proven wrong but i dont think we are there yet

Maybe a few months more and we might

comments.author: nhami
comments.body:
Soon or at least sooner than one think.

3d assets models are progressing and they are now capable of generating pretty good low poly 3d assets.

The level of detail that can be generated is slowly increasing.

Your image have a lot of details in the character and world so it hard for current models but if this progress keep happening then surely the models will be capable of generating this type of image in high-detailed 3d assets.

comments.author: Optimal-Estimate6576
comments.body: A viking survival game... What a revolutionary concept... Anyway, you already can make games that look pretty much like that you just have to know how to use the right tools
